password.title: Change password
password.signsOutOthers: Changing your password signs out every other device signed in to the account.

email.title: Email notifications
email.intro: Every notification appears in the bell at the top of the page. Here you choose which ones also arrive by email.
email.loadFailed: Your preferences cannot be loaded right now.
email.allOff: You asked to stop all email from the platform.

role.title: Permission request
role.pending: Your request for {{role}} permissions is awaiting an admin's approval. Until then the account keeps its current permissions.
role.rejected: Your previous request for {{role}} permissions was not approved.
role.rejectedReason: Your previous request for {{role}} permissions was not approved. Reason: {{reason}}
role.tryAgainLater: You can submit a new request after seven days.
role.current: Your current permission: {{role}}. A request for a higher permission needs an admin's approval.

avatar.hint: JPG, PNG or WebP. After choosing, you pick which part of the picture is shown.
avatar.notImage: The file cannot be read as a picture. You can upload a JPG, PNG or WebP.
avatar.label: Profile picture

welcome.title: Welcome, {{name}}!
welcome.body: Would you like to add a profile picture? It helps lecturers and classmates recognise you in courses and sessions.
welcome.where: You can add or change your picture at any time on the "My account" page.

crop.title: Edit your profile picture
crop.hint: Drag the picture to position it, and zoom in or out to choose the part shown in the circle.
crop.area: Crop area — drag or use the arrows to move, + and − to zoom

camera.title: Take a profile picture
camera.denied: Access to the camera was blocked. You can allow it in your browser's settings, or upload a picture from your device.
camera.none: No camera was found on this device. You can upload a picture from your device.
camera.failed: The camera could not be started. You can upload a picture from your device.
